snippet.title: Sonic Before the Sequel '26 Demo 1 - Extended Release Trailer | SAGE 2025
snippet.description:
Sonic Before the Sequel '26 is a remake of the original Sonic Before the Sequel (2011), with improved physics, visuals and controls!
The current DEMO features the first 2 zones of the game, with remade visual, enemies and bosses.

Play the SAGE 2025 Demo Now!
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-before-the-sequel-26-demo-1.2724/



Created by Facundo Gomez and Usumily
Main Programmer: Usumily
https://www.youtube.com/@Usumily
Main Artist: Facundo Gomez
https://www.youtube.com/@facundogomez8423 

Original Game by Lake Feperd

Trailer by XavierClanck
